title: Blueprint
description: An exploded Bayyinah TV laptop, drawn in cobalt across citron and cyan. Explore the layers, then the work.
signature: A laptop separates into glass, display and base while live leader lines trace the moving parts; scrolling assembles the device again.
holdback: The composition is more deliberate than Studio and avoids a giant personal name. Its actual labels explain display glass, public web screen and laptop base, however, rather than the project's architecture. Assemble and Explode manipulate a prop; project navigation and understanding survive its removal. The visible separation is not evidence of the owner's software layers.
slopCauses: Exploded laptop is the main visual device.
Generic role statement supplies the opening developer story.
